name: The Ogres of Feralas
summary: In Feralas, Rok Orhan sends you southwest of Camp Mojache to drive back the Gordunni ogres. You have proved yourself a true fighter, and he trusts you with this work in the High Wilderness.

sections.title: Into the High Wilderness
sections.body:
Rok Orhan trusts you with this work because you have proved yourself a true fighter. Southwest of Camp Mojache, the High Wilderness holds abandoned, wrecked structures on ground the night elves once owned.

Withered trees and desecrated ground mark the Gordunni's territory. Rok warns that these ogres are far tougher than the earlier ones. Ten Gordunni Shamans, ten Gordunni Warlocks and five Gordunni Maulers are to fall.

faq.q: Who sends you to the High Wilderness?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan sends you from Camp Mojache.
The Gordunni are in the High Wilderness, southwest of Camp Mojache, around wrecked structures on ground the night elves once owned. Withered trees and desecrated ground mark the spot.
Ten Gordunni Shamans, ten Gordunni Warlocks and five Gordunni Maulers must fall.
Before this step, Rok Orhan sent you against the ogres at their outpost to the north.
